subject: CanFire's full conjunct set, the native reload and barrel cadence, and whether HEAVYARTILLERY's 29 shots on IJN01 are a faithful cadence or a wrong gate.
reuses: include/bsp/gun_aiming.hpp: GunFireGateInputs, gun_can_fire_00729a80, gun_can_fire_turning_0085a830, gun_aim_settled_0085ae4a, kGunAimDeadBand

docs/GUN_AIMING.md CanFire table; docs/GUN_PLATFORM_ARC.md fixed-step tick and gun+358h; docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md gun field table and Fire step list; docs/GUN_MOUNT_POSITIONS.md muzzle vector; docs/GUN_BOT_TICKS.md bot slot map and 006DF520; docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md fire-parameter record; docs/AA_VERTICAL_WINDOW.md targeted-tick counters

answer.verdict: 29 is faithful in shape. The two HEAVYARTILLERY device rows that fire on IJN01 both author ReloadTime = 17.5 s; a 25 s window admits two firing opportunities per barrel, so hundreds was never the number. There is no missing gate. The cadence has one real error, the host's barrel count, worth a factor of two or three in both directions.
answer.can_fire_conjuncts: 00729A80 BSP_Gun_CanFire, __thiscall(gun)(bool checkReload) -> bool, RET 4, body 00729A80-00729B88. (1) 00729A83 [[gun+3F8h]+34h] != 0, the NEG/SBB/TEST 0E19983h idiom being a plain null check; (2) 00729A9E gun+3B8h == 0; (3) 00729AA7 gun+358h <= 0 signed, the destroyed-state level; (4) 00729ABC !checkReload || (gun+450h <= 0 && gun+478h <= 0); (5) 00729ADD !006D1E50(kind) || [[gun+3F0h]+6F8h] <= 0; (6) 00729B0C kind != 7 || [[gun+3F0h]+6FCh] <= 0; (7) 00729B2A muzzle.y >= 1.0 (00D7A24C) or (!00728A90(gun) && !005459B0(gun)); (8) 00729B53 gun+448h > 0 and some barrel i has !checkReload || gun[+414h][i] <= 0, the only true path. Ammunition is NOT a conjunct: it is enforced after the shot in 0072D520.
answer.predicates: 006D1E50 takes the weapon kind in ECX and answers true for {2,3,4,6}, the artillery set. 005459B0 is the same predicate reading the kind from [[gun+3F4h]+80h]. 00728A90 answers true for {1,5,6}, the anti-air set. Their union is {1..6}, so test 7 reads: a gun of kind 1..6 whose muzzle is below y = 1.0 cannot fire; kind 0 and kinds >= 7 are exempt.
answer.host_models: Of the eight, the host models 4 and 8 live, 6 structurally with a always-zero input, 7 partially (y live, both predicates hard-coded false), and 1, 2, 3 as faithful constants. Test 5 is not modelled at all.
answer.cadence: Per Fire call: 007302C4 picks the first barrel with a timer <= 0 scanning forward from gun+44Ch; ONE projectile is spawned; 007309E8 rearms that barrel; 007309ED advances the cursor modulo gun+448h; 00730A05 sets gun+450h = [gun+3F8h]+30h, the authored BarrelDelayTime. 0072D520 consumes a round and writes gun[+414h][barrel] = 00BD2F10([gun+3F8h]+28h, [gun+3F8h]+2Ch), or FLT_MAX when the provider is empty. 0072CF00 divides by 008E6430(8, unit) when the value is below FLT_MAX and both mode guards are set, then stores. Per fixed step 0072D130 decrements gun+478h and gun+450h unconditionally and advances only barrel timers that are not already negative. Steady state: an opening burst of M shots spaced D apart because every timer starts at 0, then min(1/D, M/R) shots per second.
answer.salvo: One Fire call spawns one projectile. class+0CCh OneTimeBulletAmount appears zero times and class+0D0h MultiBulletConeAngle once in this installation's arcade device table, so a salvo is one shot here. That is a data property, not a rule of the engine.
answer.barrel_count_producer: gun+448h is not a Lua field. 0072E713 calls 0072AB80(gunClass) = max(1, (class+0A0h - class+9Ch)/0Ch), the size of the class muzzle vector, which 00732560 copies verbatim from the model's "fire" node group. It is a model property.
answer.reload_producer: FUN_007313E0 reads ReloadTime: when it is not a number it takes ReloadTime[1] into +28h and ReloadTime[2] into +2Ch; when it is a number it writes the same value to both. Every ReloadTime in this installation's arcade table is a number, so 00BD2F10(R, R) = R and the native reload is deterministic here, which makes the host's fixed reload_time faithful.
answer.no_settle: The reconstruction's settle test is too strict by exactly ten times per axis, and is taken from the wrong routine. 0085AE4A is an early-out inside the angle stepper 0085AD80; src/game_hosts_gunnery.cpp:1400 reuses it as a want_fire conjunct with kGunAimDeadBand = 0.00017453 rad (0.01 deg). HEAVYARTILLERY is kind 2,3,4,6, which 0072C6A0 maps to the ArtilleryGunnerBot at gun+398h, tick 006DF520, whose own arming gate is 006DEE40(gun+480h, h, *00CF9054) with *00CF9054 = 0.0017453 rad (0.1 deg). The 1828 lost gun-ticks are 13% of the 13886 targeted refusals; the binding constraint on the shot count is the 17.5 s reload, so this is a faithfulness correction and is NOT proposed as a way to raise the count.
answer.expected_shot_bound: Maryland and West Virginia carry device 205 (vehicle 315 Colorado 1941, ReloadTime 17.5, BarrelDelayTime 0.6, one Bullet row); Massachusetts and Iowa carry device 516 (vehicle 321 South Dakota 1920 16'' 3X, same numbers, one Bullet row). With the host's M = 1 an engaged gun fires when it settles and once 17.5 s later: two shots in 25 s, which is exactly what the per-gun table prints for all thirteen continuously engaged rows, with 1 for the five that engage after t = 7.5 s or lose the target. With the native M (2 for a twin, 3 for the South Dakota triple) the same guns would fire 4 and 6, so roughly 60 to 90 shots for cat 4, not hundreds. Cat 6 runs the other way: Downes and Cassin platforms 4 and 5 are single 5'' mounts with two ammunition rows and R = 5.0, so the host's M = 2 prints 10 shots each where a single-muzzle mount fires 1 + floor(24.6/5) = 5.
answer.refusal_rate: The 98-99% can_fire_refusals rate is arithmetically required, not a symptom: a gun holding the latch and firing every 17.5 s must refuse 349 of every 350 ticks at 20 Hz. 7628 fire messages over 52 trigger_rises is an average held latch of 147 ticks = 7.3 s, shorter than one reload, which is why an engaged gun usually gets its opening burst and nothing more within one episode.
answer.stagger: trigger_rises = 52 closes the fire-start stagger. gun+478h is seeded 52 times at up to 0.12 s (00CE81A8) across 606 guns x 25 s = 15150 gun-seconds, at most 6.2 gun-seconds of block in total. The stagger is not why anything fails to fire.

assumptions: That a 3X mount's model carries three "fire" nodes. The mechanism is proven - gun+448h is the size of the class muzzle vector and 00732560 copies that vector verbatim from the model's "fire" group - but the group's contents are the model/resource packet's contract and were not read. The 2X/3X/4X in the device Comment strings and the mod author's own RPM_RT(RPM, BarrelNum) = BarrelNum/(RPM/60) helper are corroboration, not a recovered source. The factor of two to three in divergence 1 is a well-supported estimate, not a measurement.

prescription: gun.barrel_num (src/game_hosts_gunnery.cpp:434) is the count of Bullet[i] sub-tables; the native gun+448h is the model's "fire" node count. These are different quantities and the host's is wrong in both directions. The Lua device table cannot supply it; either take it from the model or label the field a stand-in in the header and in the run log so that no later reading treats a cat-4 or cat-6 shot count as a cadence result.
